svg.title: Reported physical MV-150 two-edge camera result
svg.desc: The user-reported physical camera image, mapped to a 39 by 39 millimetre object-space field of view, has an approximately 35 by 39 millimetre usable-bright threshold contour. The remaining four millimetres on the fold axis appear as two approximately two millimetre dark-edge bands. This end-to-end camera result is narrower than the nominal cube and source envelopes. The equivalent tilted-aperture width A equivalent of about forty-nine and a half millimetres is only a fitted model proxy, not a physical stop.
